#  35210 - Grid Operation with Decentralized Power Generation 2 (Network Protection) Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **35210 - module is no longer offered from WS 2008/9**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Grid Operation with Decentralized Power Generation 2 (Network Protection)**  |  
|  Netzbetrieb mit dezentraler Erzeugung (Netzschutz)   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schwarz, Harald 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students will get a deeper understanding of the interaction between analogue or digital protection systems, designed for a classical feeding situation and now faced with a large amount of dispersed generation, especially to the medium and low voltage grid.  |  
| Contents:  | discriminating protective systems, determining of settings, selectivity characteristic, tripping characteristic, different kinds of tripping devices  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Introduction in Electrical Power SystemsTechnology for Decentralized Power Generation and Storage 1 + 2  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Script, reference books about power supply (Herold, Noack, Heuck, Crastan)  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | written examination, 90 min  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 01.10.2008
